description: This file contains internal utility functions and validation logic for managing and checking shard metadata in distributed tensor sharding within PyTorch. It includes functions for overlap detection, validation of non-overlapping shards, tensor compatibility checks, and sharding parameter computations.

classes.name: ShardMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata information for a shard, including offsets and sizes.

methods.name: _check_shard_metadata_pair_overlap(shard1: ShardMetadata, shard2: ShardMetadata)
methods.description: Checks if two shard metadata objects overlap.

methods.name: tuple[int,int]|None _find_nd_overlapping_shards( shards: list[ShardMetadata], sharded_dims: list[int] )
methods.description: Finds overlapping shards across multiple dimensions using a sweep-line algorithm.

methods.name: tuple[int,int]|None _find_1d_overlapping_shards( shards: list[ShardMetadata], dim: int )
methods.description: Finds overlapping shards along a single dimension.

methods.name: validate_non_overlapping_shards_metadata(shards: list[ShardMetadata])
methods.description: Ensures that a list of shard metadata objects do not overlap.

methods.name: None check_tensor(shards_metadata, tensor_dims)
methods.description: Verifies that the shards metadata are compatible with the tensor dimensions.

methods.name: get_split_size(dim_size, chunks)
methods.description: Calculates the size of each chunk when splitting a dimension.

methods.name: get_chunked_dim_size(dim_size, split_size, idx)
methods.description: Calculates the dimension size of a specific chunk.

methods.name: get_chunk_sharding_params(sharding_dim_size, world_size, spec, rank)
methods.description: Generates start position and chunk size for sharding a tensor dimension across processes.
